name: silver_history
description: SCD2 history: version flags agree with the dates and every direct successor changes a value [671] to [673] [714] [715]

kwargs.unexpected_rows_query: SELECT * FROM {batch} WHERE is_current <> (valid_to IS NULL)

SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, lag(valid_to) OVER by_key AS previous_to, lag(state_code) OVER by_key AS previous_state_code, lag(county_fips) OVER by_key AS previous_county_fips, lag(ssa_county_code) OVER by_key AS previous_ssa_county_code, lag(zip_code) OVER by_key AS previous_zip_code, lag(provider_subtype_code) OVER by_key AS previous_provider_subtype_code, lag(control_type_code) OVER by_key AS previous_control_type_code, lag(termination_code) OVER by_key AS previous_termination_code, lag(cbsa_urban_rural_code) OVER by_key AS previous_cbsa_urban_rural_code, lag(bed_count) OVER by_key AS previous_bed_count, lag(certified_bed_count) OVER by_key AS previous_certified_bed_count FROM {batch} WINDOW by_key AS (PARTITION BY ccn ORDER BY valid_from)) WHERE CASE WHEN previous_to IS NULL THEN is_after_gap WHEN is_after_gap THEN previous_to >= valid_from ELSE previous_to <> valid_from END

SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, lag(valid_to) OVER by_key AS previous_to, lag(state_code) OVER by_key AS previous_state_code, lag(county_fips) OVER by_key AS previous_county_fips, lag(ssa_county_code) OVER by_key AS previous_ssa_county_code, lag(zip_code) OVER by_key AS previous_zip_code, lag(provider_subtype_code) OVER by_key AS previous_provider_subtype_code, lag(control_type_code) OVER by_key AS previous_control_type_code, lag(termination_code) OVER by_key AS previous_termination_code, lag(cbsa_urban_rural_code) OVER by_key AS previous_cbsa_urban_rural_code, lag(bed_count) OVER by_key AS previous_bed_count, lag(certified_bed_count) OVER by_key AS previous_certified_bed_count FROM {batch} WINDOW by_key AS (PARTITION BY ccn ORDER BY valid_from)) WHERE NOT is_after_gap AND previous_to = valid_from AND previous_state_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM state_code AND previous_county_fips IS NOT DISTINCT FROM county_fips AND previous_ssa_county_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ssa_county_code AND previous_zip_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM zip_code AND previous_provider_subtype_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM provider_subtype_code AND previous_control_type_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM control_type_code AND previous_termination_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM termination_code AND previous_cbsa_urban_rural_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cbsa_urban_rural_code AND previous_bed_count IS NOT DISTINCT FROM bed_count AND previous_certified_bed_count IS NOT DISTINCT FROM certified_bed_count
